richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Dibrugarh

c: Dibrugarh sits on the Brahmaputra in upper Assam, about 2,410 km by road from our factory in Vasai. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to tea estate staff colonies, schools, colleges, hospitals' staff quarters and municipal parks in and around the city. A delivery this far takes planning, and the more complete your order, the simpler the trip.

We suggest settling the full layout before dispatch. Decide the number of machines, mark where each will stand and check the ground. Then everything travels in one load, and our installation team or dealer in the northeast can finish the work in one visit. Send us the plot size and photographs. We will send a layout drawing with the clear space around each station, and once you approve it and the quote, we start manufacturing.

richText.heading: Planning for upper Assam's long rainy season

c: Rain in Dibrugarh starts early and runs for months, and low ground near the river can stay waterlogged. Raise the gym area above the path, give it a slope for drainage and grout each base so it does not settle in wet soil. Galvanised frames handle the damp, but check the bearings after the rains. Winters here are mild and dry, which is the easiest season for installation work.

items.q: Can you deliver outdoor gym equipment as far as Dibrugarh?
items.a: Yes. We send the equipment by road from Vasai and install it with our own team or a dealer in the northeast. Fixing the full layout before dispatch keeps it to one trip.

items.q: How do we protect the gym area from waterlogging?
items.a: Build the area slightly higher than the surrounding ground, slope it for drainage and grout the bases in concrete. Do not place machines in a dip where rainwater collects.
